admission.justification: Archive publication checks in worktrees/integration/terminal_enclosure_archive.py and provider-skip preview in worktrees/modules/terminal_group.py prevent stranding or silently overriding accepted cleanup arguments.

applicability: Fresh cleanup requests with teardown_providers=False and retries of already-accepted terminal archives.
conditions: A fresh request with live provider-runtime state and teardown_providers=False refuses before publishing a terminal archive.
Once a terminal archive is published, retries preserve its saved operation and cleanupArguments.
exclusions: Cleanups with teardown_providers=True proceed through normal provider teardown.

evidence: The Worker freeze report binds focused verification on this tree.

statement: Cleanup checks provider state before publishing a fresh archive and keeps the saved operation and arguments after acceptance.
title: Cleanup checks providers before archiving and keeps accepted retry arguments
